summary: Completed Module 07 Step 1 (CONTEXT) micro-exercise, internalizing the blameless engineering mindset and structural transformation from blame language to systems invariants.
evidence: Completed micro-exercise: transformed 'The junior developer pushed untested code to production, causing the outage' into blameless systems language: 'A code change was deployed to production without passing through the test suite. The deployment pipeline did not enforce automated test passage as a mandatory pull request merge requirement.'
Internalized core principle: Humans make mistakes; systems that permit a human typo, unvalidated parameter, or missing test to reach production unchecked are defective.
Committed to the three postmortem pillars: 1) What happened? 2) Why did the system allow it to happen? 3) What do we change so this entire CLASS of failure cannot recur?
Ready to advance to Step 2 (DECIDE) in Module 07.
